name: How much does a workplace injury attorney cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a workplace injury attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most workplace injury attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you generally do not pay any upfront fees. Instead, the attorney's fee is a percentage of the compensation they recover for you. If they don't secure a settlement or award, you typically don't owe them attorney's fees. This arrangement allows injured workers to pursue their claims without worrying about immediate legal costs.
